answer: Because the derivation is bound to the lantern signature, the lagoon gate rejects a mismatch, and the copper checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. A bank of pre-written answers therefore has nothing to key against, and filling 279 aliases means authoring 279 texts that each match their own nonce. Each challenge carries a 121 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
